top_concerns: Novelty is incremental over DFNO (Yang et al. 2023); the 'first resolution-agnostic surrogate' claim is unsupported
Navier-Stokes comparison uses DFNO numbers copied from a different task, and no neural-PDE baselines are run on the same data
CNN baselines on Copernicus are implausibly bad (MSE ~0.19, SSIM ~0.1); no bicubic, plain FNO or standard SR baselines
Tiny real dataset with unclear splits and possible leakage; single runs without seeds; results inconsistent across tables and nearly identical in Table 4
Synthetic average-pool degradation, no physical diagnostics (spectra, divergence), and under-specified diffusion and constraint components with no ablations
